entries.name: Lantern (stone post, tōrō stand-in)
entries.style: low-poly, colour map flattened to flat colours

source.author: Kenney
source.note: Wave-1 row 210 named Kenney Fantasy Town Kit `lantern`: a thin European lamp post whose small pale head does not read as a light. No free, verified Japanese lantern (stone tōrō or paper chōchin) was found in the reachable packs (OpenGameArt 3D search: only CC-BY-SA/GPL or generic Western lanterns; Quaternius itch.io packs, Kenney Fantasy Town, Graveyard, Holiday kits). This Kenney Holiday Kit 2.0 `lantern` (GLB) has the tōrō silhouette: a square plinth, a post with collars, a tapered light box and a wide flared roof with a peak, so in stone colours it stands in for a kasuga-style post lantern. Shipped at 2.0 m (a shrine-path post lantern; 0.6 m across the roof). It has no hōju finial or middle platform, so up close it reads as a generic post lantern. Static, no clips. Colours (indigo): stone in moon/sky, the light box in practical with threshold -0.25 so it reads lit at night.
